cadorReturns.title: Cador — debt honored
cadorReturns.description: You recognize him before he sees you. Cador. In better shape than last time. He gives you a discreet sign from an alcove. 'Didn't think I'd run into you this soon. I haven't forgotten.'
cadorReturns.c0Msg: He gives you a solid lead. +10 rep, new quest{{targetSuffix}}.
cadorReturns.c1: Ask him for info on the area
cadorReturns.c1Msg: He briefs you on the local situation. Info worth its weight in gold. +credits.
cadorReturns.c2Msg: He nods. 'You saved my skin once. That's enough for mutual respect.' He leaves.
cadorReturns.questDesc: Cador has a target on {{station}}. 'With my tactical help, you've got 30% better odds. I owe you one.' He gives you all the info you need.

transfugeVengeance.title: Someone's looking for the informant
transfugeVengeance.description: A poster. Your rough description. 'Wanted for betrayal — reward'. She survived. And she knows it was you. These people have networks.
transfugeVengeance.c0: Ignore it and hope she doesn't find you
transfugeVengeance.c0Msg: You pass by. For now, she doesn't see you. But the poster is fresh.
transfugeVengeance.c1: Try to talk to her — attempt an explanation
transfugeVengeance.c1Success: She listens. She doesn't forget — but she understands the context. Tension lowered. +8 rep.
transfugeVengeance.c1Fail: The conversation goes badly. She wasn't alone. -HP, -10 rep.
transfugeVengeance.c2: Pay her to take down the poster (500 cr)
transfugeVengeance.c2Insufficient: Not enough credits. The poster stays.
transfugeVengeance.c2Msg: -500 cr. She takes the money. The poster disappears. The grudge, less certain.

scientistGift.title: A package with no sender
scientistGift.description: A kid hands you a package. No name. No address. Just a scribbled note: 'For the one who gave me a chance. I don't forget.' Inside, something useful.
scientistGift.c0Implant: A quality implant. Lab work. Genuine value. +1 Implant.
scientistGift.c0Credits: {{amount}} credits in cash. He's done well for himself since.
scientistGift.c0Data: Confidential research data. +15 rep and something exploitable.

delateurReputation.title: Word travels
delateurReputation.description: A contact you knew by sight looks at you differently now. He looks away as you approach. An informant's reputation travels fast in this world.
delateurReputation.c0Success: He listens. He's not convinced, but he lets you talk. +5 rep (effort acknowledged).
delateurReputation.c0Fail: He doesn't want to hear it. He leaves. -12 rep. These people talk to each other.
delateurReputation.c1: Own it and lean into it
delateurReputation.c1Msg: A faction contacts you — they're looking for exactly someone unscrupulous. Morally shaky, financially interesting. -8 rep, +credits.
delateurReputation.c2Msg: You move on. Reputations take time to build and time to fade.

escapeLegend.title: The escape rumor
escapeLegend.description: Someone in a bar tells a story — an escape from an interrogation post. The details match what you lived through. Your legend precedes you.
escapeLegend.c0Msg: +12 rep. An escape reputation is an asset in some circles.
escapeLegend.c1: Deny it — too dangerous to be known
escapeLegend.c1Msg: You dispute the rumor. Some believe you. Others less so. -5 rep (you seem nervous).
escapeLegend.c2: Capitalize — present yourself as an escape consultant
escapeLegend.c2Msg: A serious client. Extraction on {{station}}. +credits upfront.
escapeLegend.questDesc: Your escape reputation earned you a contract. Someone wants out of {{station}} quietly. High pay, real risk.

pistisRecommends.title: Recommendation from Pistis
pistisRecommends.description: A man in a plain suit approaches. 'Pistis gave me your name. He says you're someone reliable.' He has something to propose.
pistisRecommends.c0Msg: A mission via Pistis's channels. +10 Cesarion standing, +8 Emporium rep.
pistisRecommends.questDesc: Through Pistis, an Emporium contact entrusts you with a delivery to {{station}}. Absolute discretion. Above-market pay.

caelMessage.title: Message from Cael
caelMessage.description: An encrypted message on your ship's terminal. Black Falcons signature. Cael. Short: 'I need an outsider. Interested?'
caelMessage.c0Msg: Mission received from the Falcons. +12 Falcon rep.
caelMessage.c1Msg: You don't reply. He might send it again another time.
caelMessage.questDesc: Cael needs an outsider for an operation the Falcons can't officially run on {{station}}. Real risk. Exceptional pay.

opportunistRep.title: The opportunist reputation
opportunistRep.description: Someone approaches with a calculating smile. 'I've heard about you. Someone who knows how to take advantage of a situation. Exactly the profile I need.'
opportunistRep.c0Msg: A mission that matches your reputation. High pay.
opportunistRep.c1: Reject it — you want to change your image
opportunistRep.c1Msg: He shrugs. You feel slightly better about yourself. +5 rep (effort).
opportunistRep.questDesc: A job with no name on {{station}}. Legal in the details. Morally murky overall. Pay well above market.

defectorGratitude.title: A message from the other side
defectorGratitude.description: The defector you had smuggled aboard found you. A short voice message: 'I made it. I'm safe. If you're ever out that way, you have a friend.'
defectorGratitude.c0Msg: +15 rep. You now have a contact in a defector network. Could come in handy.
defectorGratitude.c1Msg: You read the message. You don't reply. She'll understand.

cesarionBountyHunter.title: Hunter sent by the Emporium
cesarionBountyHunter.description: He wears an imperial accreditation badge. Your name is on his list. Cesarion's Emporium doesn't forget those who wronged them.
cesarionBountyHunter.c0Success: You vanish into the crowd. He keeps searching.
cesarionBountyHunter.c0Fail: He saw you. Reinforcements arrive fast. Cell.
cesarionBountyHunter.c2: Pay to have your name erased (800 cr)
cesarionBountyHunter.c2Insufficient: Not enough credits. He watches you. He waits.
cesarionBountyHunter.c2Msg: -800 cr. He passes the message along. Emporium standing recovers slightly.

raphazarusFavor.title: Courier from The Lost Arc
raphazarusFavor.description: A messenger in discreet armor. He doesn't give his name. He hands you a sealed cylinder. 'From the one who holds The Lost Arc. You behaved properly there.'
raphazarusFavor.c0Relics: Artifacts from the Great War. Authentic. Priceless. +Relics, +Artifacts.
raphazarusFavor.c0Credits: {{amount}} credits and a letter of recommendation. +20 rep. Raphazarus remembers.
raphazarusFavor.c1Msg: The messenger leaves without a word. Refusing a gesture from Raphazarus is paid for differently. -10 standing.

scottyNetwork.title: Scotty's network
scottyNetwork.description: A vaguely familiar face. An employee of Scotty Golden North. He slips you something discreetly. 'Mr. Scotty says friends of the house are well taken care of.'
scottyNetwork.c0Credits: An envelope of credits. Scotty's network works well. +credits.
scottyNetwork.c0Goods: Some Scotty Golden North specialties. +2 Festive specialties.
